title: Substance Use Differentiation Questionnaire
short: A screening questionnaire to help understand your substance use patterns and whether a professional assessment is advisable.

intro.measures: This questionnaire is a tool to help understand your substance use patterns and may indicate if a professional assessment is advisable. It is not exhaustive or diagnostic but can help identify potential red flags that warrant a more thorough assessment.
intro.instructions: Please answer the following questions honestly.

placeholder.label: Which substance are you answering about? (optional)
placeholder.hint: For example alcohol, cannabis or tobacco. This stays on your device and is only used to word the questions.

questions.title: Amount of Use
questions.text: When you use [substance], how much do you typically consume?

options.label: More than I initially plan to
Exactly as much as I plan to

questions.title: Control Over Use
questions.text: Have you ever wanted to cut down or stop using [substance] but couldn’t?

questions.title: Impact on Responsibilities
questions.text: Has your use of [substance] ever led to problems at work, school, or home?

questions.title: Continued Use Despite Problems
questions.text: Do you continue to use [substance] even when it causes social or relationship problems?

questions.title: Cravings
questions.text: Do you experience strong desires or urges to use [substance]?

questions.title: Impact on Activities
questions.text: Have you given up or reduced participation in important activities because of your use of [substance]?

questions.title: Tolerance
questions.text: Have you found that you need to use more of [substance] to achieve the same effect you once had with smaller amounts?

questions.title: Withdrawal
questions.text: When you stop using [substance], do you experience withdrawal symptoms?

questions.title: Time Spent
questions.text: Do you spend a lot of time obtaining, using, or recovering from the effects of [substance]?

questions.title: Neglect of Major Roles
questions.text: Have you failed to fulfill major role obligations at work, school, or home due to substance use?

questions.title: Legal Problems
questions.text: Have you encountered legal problems due to your substance use?

scoring.assumption: ASSUMPTION, needs the doctor's review. The old site gives no numbers, only 'Primarily No' vs 'Several Yes'. Here every 'Yes' counts as one red flag; for the two multiple-choice questions only 'Daily or almost daily' and 'More than I initially plan to' count. 0 to 2 flags = 'Primarily No', 3 or more = 'Several Yes'. The 'key' questions (control, responsibilities, continued use, tolerance, withdrawal) are the ones the old site singles out; any 'Yes' to them adds the key_note line below.

bands.label: Primarily “No” responses
bands.text: May indicate social or non-problematic use, but this does not rule out the potential for substance use issues.

bands.label: Several “Yes” responses
bands.text: Several “Yes” responses may indicate a need for a comprehensive assessment by a professional.

scoring.key_note: Particularly to questions about control, impact on responsibilities, continued use despite problems, tolerance, and withdrawal, “Yes” responses may indicate a need for a comprehensive assessment by a professional.

note: This questionnaire is a simplistic tool for initial screening purposes and should not be used as a standalone diagnostic instrument. Professional evaluation is essential for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.
next_steps: If there are concerns about one’s substance use or its impact on life, consulting a healthcare professional for a thorough assessment is advisable.
